paragraphs: BJ's Restaurants is a leading full-service restaurant brand differentiated by a high-quality, varied menu with compelling value, a dining experience that offers our customers (referred to as "guests") best-in-class service, hospitality and enjoyment, in a high-energy, welcoming and approachable atmosphere. BJ's is a national restaurant chain that, as of February 27, 2026, owns and operates 219 restaurants located in 31 states.

The first BJ's restaurant opened in 1978 in Orange County, California, and was a small sit-down pizzeria that featured Chicago style deep-dish pizza with a unique California twist. In 1996, we introduced our proprietary craft beers and expanded the BJ's concept to a full-service, high-energy restaurant when we opened our first large format restaurant with an on-site brewing operation in Brea, California. Today our restaurants feature a broad menu with approximately 90 menu items designed to offer something for everyone including: slow roasted entrees and wings, EnLIGHTened Entrees® such as our Cherry Chipotle Glazed Salmon, our original signature deep-dish pizza, and the world-famous Pizookie® dessert. We also offer our award-winning BJ's craft beers, which are produced at four in-house brewing facilities, two standalone brewpubs and by independent third-party brewers using our proprietary recipes, alongside a full bar featuring innovative cocktails.

Our Internet address is https://www.bjsrestaurants.com. Electronic copies of our Annual Report on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q and current reports on Form 8-K are available, free of charge, by visiting the "Investors" section of our website. We caution that the information on our website is not part of this or any other reports we file with, or furnish to, the SEC.

We compete in the full-service segment of the domestic restaurant industry, which is a large, highly fragmented segment with estimated annual sales in the $100+ billion range. We believe that the BJ's restaurant concept offers consumers a high quality, contemporary, full-service dining experience in a high-energy environment, with a diversified menu and a best-in-class bar statement. Our primary business objective is to increase our market share in the full-service restaurant industry by consistently delivering on our "Gold Standard of Operational Excellence" promise to our guests, which is our genuine commitment to take pride in passionately connecting with every guest on every visit, through flawless and relentless execution of every detail, during every shift, to create and keep fanatical fans of BJ's. We believe that by delivering upon this commitment to our guests, while continuing our restaurant expansion program, we create the best opportunity to generate significant repeat business and capture additional market share.

While our core strategy has remained consistent, we are always striving to evolve and enhance our guests' experience. Our Gold Standard of Operational Excellence is focused on the following key areas that help differentiate BJ's from other full-service restaurants:

• High-Energy Atmosphere and Facilities – We believe that one of our greatest competitive differentiators is the design, ambiance and energy of our restaurants, which feature a signature bar statement, making them a destination for our guests to spend quality time with friends and family. As part of our competitive positioning as a polished full-service concept, our restaurants have finishes consistent with upscale full-service concepts, including high ceilings and large televisions which can be viewed from any seat and provide the comfort of a restaurant and the energy of a bar. Additionally, we use a variety of higher quality guest touchpoints, including distinctive glassware to fit the beer or beverage style and linen napkins not generally found in "mass-market" full-service restaurants. Since 2022, we have been engaged in a remodel initiative to ensure that our restaurants maintain their contemporary look and feel. The initiative has several different remodel iterations depending on the age and condition of the restaurant.

• Broad and Distinctive Menu – BJ's culinary and menu strategy centers around serving guests craveable food and beverage items that are familiar yet add a brewhouse twist that makes them unique and differentiated. Our concept includes menu options that meet our guests' preferences for any dining occasion, and our menu items are created by our talented culinary team and prepared to order in our restaurants using high-quality ingredients. Our menu features a wide variety of choices, ensuring there's something for everyone, and we are able to modify nearly every menu item to satisfy any guest's request to ensure it is "made their way." We evaluate our menu offerings and prices two to three times a year in addition to offering seasonal or limited time only menu items throughout the year. In November 2025, we reimagined our signature deep-dish pizza from the crust up—introducing reformulated hand-pressed dough, sauce made with vine-ripened tomatoes, and a new creamy mozzarella blend. These product enhancements were supported by updated training procedures to ensure consistent execution. We believe the initiative will strengthen a core brand pillar, elevate the guest experience, and reinforce our commitment to quality and innovation. While we have reimaged our deep-dish pizza, we still continue to offer almost 20 signature flavors and made-to-order combinations in both our tavern-cut and deep-dish styles. In addition to our pizza, we also offer slow roast large format proteins including prime rib, wings, double bone-in pork chops and tri-tip sirloin, as well as our better-for-you EnLIGHTened Entrees®.

• Award Winning, Proprietary Craft Beer – All of our restaurants feature BJ's award-winning craft beer, which showcases the quality and care of the ingredients used at BJ's. Our high-quality, craft beer further differentiates BJ's from many other restaurant concepts and complements our broad menu. Since 1996, our beers have earned 275 medals at different beer festivals and events, including 39 medals at the Great American Beer Festival and 13 medals at the World Beer Cup. In 2025, with the addition of our hard root beer and hard lemonade, we now offer 14 year-round signature BJ's beers and "beyond beer" options as well as one or more rotating seasonal BJ's beers on tap at any one time. We also offer approximately 20 domestic, imported and "guest" craft beers on tap, in addition to a selection of bottled beers. Additionally, our restaurants offer our craft beer and cider for take-out in cans or growlers, where legally permitted. Our expansive and unique beer offerings are intended to enhance BJ's competitive positioning as a leading craft beer retailer in full-service dining. We also offer our BJ's Brewhouse Beer Club throughout most of California. Our club is a subscription service, which features special and unique beer from BJ's brewers and restaurant traffic-driving perks that are only available to club members.

• Everyday Value Proposition – We strive to offer great everyday value throughout our menu, with diverse price points and unique flavor profiles. Our menu entrées, excluding our promotional specials, generally range in price from $8.99 to $35.99. We also offer Daily Brewhouse Specials, which feature some of our most iconic food and drink items at a lower price, as well our weekday Pizookie Meal Deal and happy hour offerings, where permitted, to reinforce our everyday value proposition. Additionally, we offer a series of take-out and delivery specific Family Meals and Bundles that serve 4 to 6 guests. These packages start at $50.00, make it easy to order for a family or larger group, and further enhance our value proposition.

• A Culture Committed to WOW Hospitality and Service – Completely satisfying dining experiences start with engaged, knowledgeable, and hospitable people. We have invested carefully to recruit, select, train, and retain employees,

referred to as "team members," who can take care of our guests with WOW-level hospitality and consistently and efficiently execute our recipes and steps of service. In addition to hiring quality team members, we continue to invest in productivity and hospitality programs to enhance our ability to consistently deliver the high standards of operational performance we promise our guests. These programs include a Net Promoter Scoring program that helps us evaluate several key elements of our service including pace, hospitality, value and recommend scores, as well as mystery shopper and guest loyalty programs.

• Technology at the Right Time – Time is a finite resource for our guests, and we believe that by promptly being attentive to every detail, we can optimize our guests' enjoyment when they choose to dine with us. Our handheld ordering tablets improve our pace and productivity, including reducing the time it takes to deliver the first drink or food item to our guests. The tablets have resulted in an improved guest experience and driven higher incident rates for beverages, appetizers and desserts. Additionally, our BJ's mobile application allows our guests to use their smartphones to order ahead, add their name to our waitlist, pay at the table and manage their loyalty account, among other things. We were also one of the first in full-service dining to utilize the quick response ("QR") code and Wi-Fi geolocation technologies for both menu browsing and mobile payment to provide a touchless experience for guests who dine at our restaurants.

• Bringing the Brewhouse Home to Our Guests – Consumer preferences continue to evolve as e-commerce, mobile shopping and "food-on-demand" continue to gain traction and direct visits away from traditional brick-and-mortar shopping locations. To meet these opportunities, we have invested in the off-premise sales channel by creating new off-premise menu items, expanding our catering menu, collaborating with third-party delivery partners to provide delivery service from our restaurants, updated our website to make ordering easier for our guests, and we continue to improve our take-out and curbside experience. We also have enhanced our technology for the off-premise sales channel by leveraging our self-developed mobile application, our website and other platforms to ensure our guests can more easily enjoy BJ's menu from home or the office. This includes web-based order tracker, contactless curbside pickup with short message service ("SMS") text and email technology to keep our guests informed of the status of their order and allow them to notify the restaurant when they arrive. These ongoing system and operational improvements are designed to improve the guest experience and drive traffic, off-premise check growth and increased catering orders. Where permitted by law, we also sell alcoholic beverages, including BJ's beer as well as wine and mixed drinks through take-out and delivery channels.

As of December 30, 2025, we employed approximately 22,000 team members at our 219 restaurants. We also employed approximately 230 team members at our Restaurant Support Center in Huntington Beach, California and in field supervision positions around the country, whose primary goal is to provide gold standard support to our restaurant teams so they can focus on serving our guests. Approximately 18% of our hourly restaurant team members provide their services on a full-time basis, as defined by the Affordable Care Act. We actively work to ensure positive team member relations and a respectful workplace, frequently reinforcing the high ethical and professional standards set forth in our Code of Integrity, Ethics and Conduct which we believe should guide every decision we make. Currently, no unions or collective bargaining arrangements are in place at our Company.

headings: Risks Related to our Restaurant Business, Operations and Future Growth

The restaurant industry is highly competitive. Any inability to maintain our brand image and compete effectively in the restaurant industry may adversely affect our revenues, profitability and financial results.
Our inability or failure to successfully and sufficiently raise menu prices to offset rising costs and expenses may adversely affect guest traffic and our results of operations.
Health concerns arising from food-borne or other illnesses or specific categories of foods may adversely affect our business.
Any deterioration in general economic conditions which adversely affects consumer spending, our landlords or businesses neighboring our locations, may adversely affect our results of operations.
Changes in consumer buying patterns, particularly e-commerce sites and off-premise sales affect our revenues, operating results and liquidity.
Any adverse change in consumer trends or traffic levels may adversely affect our business, revenues and results of operations.
Changes in off-premise sales or costs may adversely affect our operating results.
Any inability or failure to recognize, respond to and effectively manage the accelerated impact of social media may adversely affect our business.
Any inability or failure to successfully expand our restaurant operations or open and adequately staff new restaurants may adversely affect our growth rate and results of operations.
Our inability to renew existing leases on favorable terms may adversely affect our results of operations.
Any inability to retain key personnel or difficulties in recruiting qualified personnel may adversely affect our business until a suitable replacement is found.

Any adverse changes in the cost of food, brewing commodities and other materials, including cost increases caused by inflation, tariffs, or global conflicts may adversely affect our operating results.
We may be subject to increased labor costs resulting from wage pressure, higher turnover and changes in government regulations, any of which could adversely affect our results of operations.
Any adverse weather conditions, seasonal fluctuations, natural disasters and environmental matters, including the effects of climate change, may adversely affect our results of operations.
Risks Related to Data Security and Technology
Risk Related to Regulations and Legal Proceedings
Federal, state and local beer, liquor and food service regulations and any violations thereof may adversely affect our revenues and results of operations.
Compliance with cybersecurity, privacy and similar laws may involve significant costs and any failure to comply could adversely affect our business, reputation and results of operations.
We are subject to a variety of laws and regulations, and failure to comply could result in significant costs and liabilities.
We may become party to legal proceedings which could have a material adverse effect on our business.
General Risk Factors
Any inability to access sources of capital and/or to raise capital in the future on favorable terms may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
The market price of our common stock may be volatile, and our shareholders may lose all or part of their investment.
paragraphs: The risk factors presented below may affect our future operating results, financial position and cash flows. The risks described in this Item 1A and other sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K are not exhaustive and are not the only risks we may ever face in our business. We operate in a very competitive and rapidly changing environment. New risks and uncertainties arise from time to time, and we cannot predict those events or how they may affect us. There may be other risks and uncertainties that are not currently known or that are currently deemed by us to be immaterial. However, they may ultimately adversely affect our business, financial condition and/or operating results. In addition to the risk factors presented below, changes in general economic conditions, credit markets, consumer tastes, discretionary spending patterns, demographic trends, and consumer confidence in the economy, all of which affect consumer behavior and spending for restaurant dining occasions, may have a material impact on us.

The restaurant industry is highly competitive. We compete on the basis of the taste, quality and price of food offered, guest service, brand name identification, beer quality and selection, facilities attractiveness, restaurant location, atmosphere and overall dining experience. In addition, we compete with other restaurants and retailers for real estate. Our competitors include a large and diverse group of restaurant chains and individual restaurants that range from independent local operators that have opened restaurants in various markets to well-capitalized national restaurant companies. Many of our competitors have substantially greater financial, marketing and other resources than we do.

In addition to other full-service restaurants, we face competition from an array of food-away-from-home alternatives, including fast casual restaurants, single-serve operations, quick-service restaurants and the trend toward convergence in grocery, deli and restaurant services, particularly in the supermarket industry which offers "convenient meals" in the form of improved entrées and side dishes from the deli section. We also continue to face pressure for consumer discretionary spending on restaurant occasions, as well as less expensive alternatives to BJ's.

Our ability to effectively compete in the restaurant industry, the successful operation of the BJ's restaurant concept and the execution of our national expansion plan are all highly dependent upon BJ's ability to remain relevant to consumers and being a brand they trust. Any incident that erodes consumer trust in or affinity for the BJ's brand may significantly reduce its value. If consumers perceive or experience any reduction in our food or beverage quality, service or facility ambiance, or in any way believe we failed to deliver a consistently positive dining experience, our ability to compete and the value of the BJ's brand may be impaired. In addition, if other restaurants are able to promote and deliver a higher degree of perceived value through heavy discounting or other methods, our guest traffic levels may suffer, which would adversely impact our revenues and profitability.

In the past, we have experienced dramatic price increases of certain items necessary to operate our restaurants and brewing operations, including increases in the cost of food, commodities, labor, team member benefits, insurance arrangements, construction, energy and other costs. We utilize menu price increases to help offset the increased cost of commodities, minimum wage and other costs. However, there is no guarantee that our menu price increases will be accepted by our guests. If our costs increase, our operating profit and results of operations will be adversely affected if we are unable to increase our menu prices to offset such increased costs or if our increased menu prices result in less guest traffic. In addition, we cannot provide assurance that menu price increases will not deter guests from visiting our restaurants, reduce the frequency of their visits or affect their purchasing decisions.

Negative publicity about us, our restaurants, other restaurants, or others across the food supply chain, due to foodborne illness or for other reasons, whether or not accurate, may adversely affect the reputation and popularity of our restaurants and our results of operations.

paragraphs: The following Management's Discussion and Analysis ("MD&A") of Financial Condition and Results of Operations is intended to help you understand our Company, our operations and our current operating environment. For an understanding of the significant factors that influenced our performance, the MD&A should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and related Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements included in Part II, Item 8 - Financial Statements and Supplementary Data of our Annual Report. Our MD&A consists of the following sections:
• Overview - a brief description of our business, financial highlights, strategy to increase shareholder value, key performance indicators, known and anticipated trends
• Results of Operations - an analysis of our Consolidated Statements of Operations for fiscal year 2025 compared to fiscal year 2024

• Liquidity and Capital Resources - an analysis of cash flows, including capital expenditures, share issuance and repurchase activity, dividends, contractual obligations and commitments, and known trends that may impact liquidity
• Critical Accounting Policies and Estimates - a discussion of accounting policies that require critical judgments and estimates, including new accounting standards, when applicable

As of February 27, 2026, we own and operate 219 restaurants located in 31 states as described in Item 2 - Properties - "Restaurant Locations" in this Form 10-K. Our restaurants are open every day of the year except for Thanksgiving and Christmas. All of our restaurants currently offer take-out and delivery services. Additionally, all of our restaurants offer a call-ahead or online wait list, on-line ordering for dine-in, guest pick-up or curbside delivery and reservations for large parties.

Our menu features BJ's award‑winning, signature deep-dish pizza, our proprietary craft and other beers, as well as a wide selection of appetizers, entrées, pastas, sandwiches, specialty salads and desserts, including our Pizookie® dessert. Our proprietary craft beer is produced at four of our restaurants with in-house brewing facilities, our Texas brewpub locations and by independent third-party brewers using our proprietary recipes.
Notable fiscal 2025 financial highlights compared to fiscal 2024 include: • Total revenues increased 3.1% to $1.4 billion
• Total restaurant operating weeks increased 0.9% • Comparable restaurant sales increased 2.0%
• Net income of $48.8 million compared to $16.7 million • Diluted net income per share of $2.16 compared to $0.70

Our goal is to increase shareholder value by increasing our adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (Adjusted EBITDA), earnings per share and return on invested capital through:
• Growing restaurant revenue through positive comparable sales and new restaurant growth
• Increasing restaurant margins through sales leverage, cost savings and culinary and menu strategies
• Enhancing new restaurant economics through restaurant margin improvement and new restaurant prototype optimization

paragraphs: BJ's Restaurants 是一家領導的全服務餐飲品牌，以高品質、多樣化的菜單與具有吸引力的價值為特色，提供顧客（稱為"顧客"）最佳等級的服務、招待與享受，營造高能量、歡迎且易近的用餐氛圍。BJ's 是一家全國性的餐飲連鎖品牌，截至 2026 年 2 月 27 日，擁有並營運 219 家餐廳，分佈於 31 個州。

第一家 BJ's 餐廳於 1978 年在加州橙縣開幕，當時是一家小型坐式披薩店，特色為芝加哥風格的深盤披薩，並加入獨特的加州風味。1996 年，我們推出自有專利的精緻啤酒，並擴展 BJ's 概念為全服務、高能量的餐廳，於加州佈雷市開設第一家大型格式餐廳，並設有現場釀酒作業。目前，我們的餐廳提供廣泛的菜單，約有 90 項餐點選擇，以滿足不同顧客的喜好，包括：慢燉主菜與炸雞翅、EnLIGHTened Entrees® 如我們的櫻桃墨西哥辣椒釉烤鮭魚、我們的原創招牌深盤披薩，以及聞名世界的 Pizookie® 烘焙甜點。我們也提供獲獎肯定的 BJ's 精緻啤酒，這些啤酒由四間內製釀酒廠、兩間獨立釀酒吧以及獨立第三方釀酒商使用我們的專利配方製造，並搭配完整的酒吧，提供創新雞尾酒。
我們的網際網路地址為 https://www.bjsrestaurants.com。電子版的年度報告（Form 10-K）、季報（Form 10-Q）及現況報告（Form 8-K）均可透過我們網站的"投資人"部分免費取得。我們提醒您，網站上的資訊並非本或任何其他向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交或提供的報告的一部分。

我們在美國國內全服務餐飲產業中競爭，這是一個規模龐大、高度分散的產業，預估年銷售額在 100+ 億美元範圍內。我們相信 BJ's 餐廳概念為消費者提供高品質、現代化、全服務的用餐體驗，於高能量環境中，並擁有多元化菜單與最佳等級的酒吧服務。我們的主要業務目標是透過持續履行我們對顧客的"優質運營卓越標準"承諾，來增加我們在全服務餐飲產業的市佔率，這是我們對每名顧客在每次造訪時，都熱情連結的真實承諾，透過無懈可擊且持續的執行每一個細節，於每次工作時段中，創造並保持 BJ's 的狂熱忠實顧客。我們相信透過履行對顧客的承諾，同時持續進行餐廳擴張計畫，我們創造了最佳機會來產生顯著的重複消費，並取得更多的市場佔有率。
雖然我們的核心策略一直保持一致，但我們始終致力於進化與提升顧客的體驗。我們的"優質運營卓越標準"聚焦於以下幾個關鍵領域，這些領域有助於 BJ's 與其他全服務餐廳區隔：

• 高能量氛圍與設施 – 我們相信，我們最大的競爭優勢之一是餐廳的設計、氛圍與能量，這些特色包括標誌性的酒吧服務，使我們的顧客能在與親友家人共度高品質的時間。作為一個精緻的全服務概念，我們的餐廳裝潢與高檔全服務概念一致，包括高天花板與大型電視螢幕，可從任何座位觀賞，提供餐廳的舒適感與酒吧的能量感。此外，我們使用多種較高品質的顧客接觸點，包括符合啤酒或飲料風格的獨特玻璃杯與一般未見於"大眾市場"全服務餐廳的紗質餐巾。自 2022 年起，我們進行了一項翻新計畫，以確保我們的餐廳維持當代的外觀與氛圍。此計畫根據餐廳的年齡與狀況有不同的翻新版本。

• 廣泛且獨特的菜單 – BJ's 的烹飪與菜單策略聚焦於提供顧客渴望的食品與飲料選擇，這些選擇既熟悉又加入釀酒廠的獨特風味，使其獨特且區隔其他選擇。我們的概念包含符合顧客不同用餐場合的餐點選擇，並由我們的才華洋溢的廚師團隊所設計，並在餐廳內使用高品質原料現點現做。我們的菜單提供廣泛的選擇，確保有東西適合每位顧客，我們也能修改幾乎所有的餐點選擇，以符合每位顧客的特別要求，確保其"按他們的方式製作"。我們每兩到三個月評估我們的菜單選擇與價格，並在全年提供季節性或限定時間的餐點選擇。2025 年 11 月，我們重新設計了我們的招牌深盤披薩，從餅皮開始，引入重新配方的手壓餅皮、使用成熟番茄製成的醬料，以及新的奶油馬蘇里拉奶酪混合。這些產品改進由更新的培訓程序支持，以確保一致的執行。我們相信此計畫將強化品牌的核心支柱，提升顧客體驗，並強化我們對品質與創新承諾。雖然我們重新設計了深盤披薩，但我們仍然繼續提供近 20 種招牌風味與現點現做組合，包括我們的 tavern-cut 與深盤披薩風格。除了披薩，我們也提供慢燉大型格式蛋白質，包括牛排、炸雞翅、雙骨豬排與三筋牛柳，以及我們的更好選擇 EnLIGHTened Entrees®。

• 獲獎肯定、自有專利的精緻啤酒 – 我們的所有餐廳都提供 BJ's 獲獎肯定的精緻啤酒，展現 BJ's 所使用的原料品質與用心。我們的高品質精緻啤酒進一步區隔 BJ's 從許多其他餐飲概念，並與我們廣泛的菜單相輔相成。自 1996 年以來，我們的啤酒在不同啤酒節與活動中獲得了 275 面獎牌，包括在美國大眾啤酒節（Great American Beer Festival）獲得 39 面獎牌，以及在世界啤酒杯（World Beer Cup）獲得 13 面獎牌。2025 年，隨著我們的硬根啤酒與硬檸檬汽水的加入，我們現在提供 14 種全年皆可享用的 BJ's 精緻啤酒與"超越啤酒"選擇，並在任何時間提供一種或更多種旋轉季節性的 BJ's 啤酒。我們也提供約 20 種國內、進口與"顧客"精緻啤酒，並搭配瓶裝啤酒的選擇。此外，我們的餐廳也提供精緻啤酒與氣泡飲料供外帶，以罐裝或 growlers 預先裝載，只要法律允許。我們廣泛且獨特的啤酒選擇旨在強化 BJ's 在全服務用餐中作為領先精緻啤酒零售商的競爭優勢。我們也提供 BJ's Brewhouse 啤酒俱樂部，遍及加州的大部分地區。此俱樂部為訂閱服務，提供 BJ's 啤酒釀造商獨特的啤酒與僅限俱樂部會員的餐廳流量促進優惠。

• 每日價值主張 – 我們致力於在餐點中提供高價值的日常選擇，擁有多樣化的價格與獨特的風味組合。我們的餐點主菜（不包含促銷專案）價格通常介於 8.99 美元至 35.99 美元之間。我們也提供每日 Brewhouse 專案，以較低價格呈現我們最具代表性的餐點與飲品，並提供週一至週五的 Pizookie 餐點優惠與歡樂時光餐點（如適用），以強化我們的日常價值主張。此外，我們也提供一系列外帶與外送專用的家庭餐點與套餐，可供 4 至 6 位客人食用。這些套餐起價為 50.00 美元，方便家庭或大型團體點餐，進一步強化我們的價值主張。

• 以 WOW 尊榮服務為核心的文化 – 完美滿意的用餐體驗始於熱情、專業且親切的服務人員。我們謹慎投資於招募、選拔、培訓與留住員工，這些員工被稱為 "團隊成員"，他們能以 WOW 等級的尊榮服務照顧顧客，並能一致且高效地執行我們的食譜與服務步驟。除了聘請高品質的團隊成員，我們持續投資於提升生產力與服務品質的方案，以強化我們對顧客承諾的高標準運營表現。這些方案包括 Net Promoter 得分評估制度，用以評估我們服務的多項關鍵要素，包括速度、服務品質、價值感與推薦分數，以及神祕顧客與顧客忠誠度計畫。

referred to as "team members," who can take care of our guests with WOW-level hospitality and consistently and efficiently execute our recipes and steps of service. In addition to hiring quality team members, we continue to invest in productivity and hospitality programs to enhance our ability to consistently deliver the high standards of operational performance we promise our guests. These programs include a Net Promoter Scoring program that helps us evaluate several key elements of our service including pace, hospitality, value and recommend scores, as well as mystery shopper and guest loyalty programs.

• 技術掌握時機 – 時間是我們顧客的有限資源，我們認為透過迅速關注每個細節，我們可以優化顧客在選擇與我們共進餐點時的體驗。我們的手持點餐平板電腦提升了我們的效率與生產力，包括減少將第一杯飲料或餐點送達顧客的時間。平板電腦已改善顧客體驗，並帶動飲料、前菜與甜點的銷售率提高。此外，我們的 BJ's 手機應用程式讓顧客能使用智慧型手機預訂餐點、將姓名加入等候名單、桌邊付款以及管理忠誠度帳戶，還有其他功能。我們也是全服務餐飲業中首批使用快速反應（"QR"）碼與 Wi-Fi 網域定位技術，用於選單瀏覽與行動付款，以提供無接觸體驗給在餐廳用餐的顧客。

• 將釀酒廠帶回家中 – 消費者偏好持續演變，隨著電子商務、行動購物與 "即食餐點" 熱潮持續興起，並將人流導離傳統實體商店。為抓住這些機會，我們已投資於外賣銷售通路，透過開發新的外賣選單項目、擴充我們的餐飲服務選單、與第三方配送合作夥伴合作提供從餐廳出發的配送服務、更新我們的網站以簡化顧客的點餐流程，並持續改善外賣與臨時停車區的體驗。我們也透過我們自發發展的行動應用程式、網站及其他平台，提升外賣銷售通路的技術，確保顧客能更輕鬆地在家或辦公室享用 BJ's 選單。這包括基於網頁的訂單追蹤、無接觸臨時停車區取餐，搭配短訊（"SMS"）文字與電子郵件技術，讓顧客能掌握訂單狀態並在到達時通知餐廳。這些持續的系統與營運改進，旨在改善顧客體驗，並帶動外賣銷售成長與餐飲服務訂單增加。在法律允許的範圍內，我們也透過外賣與配送通路銷售酒精飲料，包括 BJ's 啤酒以及葡萄酒與混合飲料。

截至 2025 年 12 月 30 日，我們在 219 家餐廳僱用了約 22,000 名員工。我們也在加州亨廷頓海灘的餐廳支援中心僱用了約 230 名員工，以及全國各地的現場管理職位，其主要目標是為餐廳團隊提供金牌標準的支援，使其能專注於服務顧客。約 18% 的我們餐廳員工為全職員工，根據《平價醫療法案》定義。我們積極努力確保員工關係正面且工作環境尊重，經常強化我們《誠信、倫理與行為準則》所設定的高道德與專業標準，我們認為這些準則應指導我們每一個決策。目前，我們公司沒有工會或集體談判安排。

paragraphs: 下列為管理層討論與分析（"MD&A"）財務狀況與營運成果之說明，旨在協助您瞭解本公司、營運狀況與目前營運環境。為瞭解影響本公司績效之重大因素，應配合本公司年度報告第二部分，第 8 項－財務報表與補充資料所附之合併財務報表與相關財務報表附註一併閱讀。本公司 MD&A 包含以下各項內容：
• 總覽－簡要說明本公司業務、財務重點、增加股東價值之策略、關鍵績效指標、已知與預期之趨勢
• 營運成果－分析本公司合併營運成果財務報表，比較財務年度 2025 與財務年度 2024
• 流動性與資本資源－分析現金流量，包括資本支出、股票發行與回購活動、股息、契約義務與承諾，以及已知可能影響流動性之趨勢
• 關鍵會計政策與會計估計－討論需運用關鍵判斷與會計估計之會計政策，包括適用之新會計準則
2026 年 2 月 27 日為基準日，本公司擁有並營運 219 家餐廳，位於 31 個州，如本 Form 10-K 第 2 項－不動產－"餐廳位置"所述。本公司餐廳全年無休，唯感恩節與聖誕節除外。所有餐廳目前均提供外帶與外送服務。此外，所有餐廳均提供預訂或線上等候名單、線上點餐（內用）、顧客自取或路邊外送服務，以及大型聚會預訂服務。
本公司餐點包含 BJ's 獨家獲獎深盤披薩、本公司專利手作及其他啤酒，以及廣泛的前菜、主菜、義麵、三明治、特製沙拉與甜點，包括本公司 Pizookie® 甜點。本公司專利手作啤酒於四家餐廳內設釀造廠生產，包含德克薩斯州釀酒餐廳，並由獨立第三方釀造商使用本公司專利配方生產。
與財務年度 2024 相較，財務年度 2025 顯著財務重點包括：• 總營收增加 3.1%，達 1.4 十億美元
• 總餐廳營運週數增加 0.9% • 同店銷售額增加 2.0%
• 網路收入為 48.8 百萬美元，較 16.7 百萬美元 • 每股稀釋後網路收入為 2.16 美元，較 0.70 美元
本公司目標為透過以下方式，提高股東價值，以提升調整後營業息稅折舊及 amortization（Adjusted EBITDA）、每股盈餘及投資資本回報率：
• 透過正面同店銷售額及新餐廳成長，增加餐廳營收
• 透過銷售槓桿、成本節省及廚藝與餐點策略，提高餐廳毛利率
• 透過餐廳毛利率改善及新餐廳原型優化，提升新餐廳經濟效益

headings: 與本公司餐廳業務、營運及未來成長相關之風險
餐廳產業競爭激烈。若無法維持本公司品牌形象並有效競爭，將不利於本公司營業收入、獲利能力及財務結果。
本公司若無法成功且足夠提高餐點價格以彌補成本與費用的上升，將不利於顧客人數及本公司營運結果。
因食物傳播或其它疾病所引發之健康問題，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
總體經濟條件惡化，不利於消費者支出、本公司租賃業者或鄰近本公司營運據點之商業活動，將對本公司營運結果造成不利影響。
消費者購買新趨勢，特別是電商網站及外帶銷售，將影響本公司營業收入、營運結果及流動性。
任何不利之消費者趨勢或人潮變化，將對本公司業務、營業收入及營運結果造成不利影響。
外帶銷售或成本之變動，可能對本公司營運結果造成不利影響。
任何無法認知、回應並有效管理社交媒體加速影響之情形，可能不利於本公司業務。
任何無法成功擴展餐廳營運或開設並充分配置人力之新餐廳，可能不利於本公司成長率及營運結果。
本公司無法以有利條件續約現有租賃契約，可能不利於本公司營運結果。
任何無法留住關鍵人員或在招募合格人員方面遇到困難，可能不利於本公司業務，直至適當之替代人選被尋獲為止。
任何食品、釀酒原料及其他材料成本之不利變動，包括因通貨膨脹、關稅或全球衝突所導致之成本增加，可能不利於本公司營運結果。
本公司可能因工資壓力、較高員工流動率及政府規範變動而面臨勞動成本增加，任何上述情形均可能不利於本公司營運結果。
任何不利天氣條件、季節性波動、天然災害及環境議題，包括氣候變遷之影響，可能不利於本公司營運結果。
與資料安全及科技相關之風險
與規範及法律程序相關的風險
聯邦、州及地方的啤酒、酒類及餐飲服務規範及其違規行為，可能對我們的收入及營運成果產生不利影響。
遵守網路安全、隱私權及類似法律可能涉及重大成本，且任何未能遵守的情況可能對我們的業務、聲譽及營運成果產生不利影響。
我們受多種法律及規範所制約，未能遵守可能導致重大成本及負債。
我們可能成為法律程序的一方，這可能對我們的業務產生重大不利影響。
一般風險因素
任何無法取得資金來源及/或未來在有利條件下籌資的狀況，可能對我們的業務及營運成果產生不利影響。
我們的普通股市場價格可能波動，股東可能喪失全部或部分投資。
paragraphs: 下列風險因素可能影響我們未來的營運成果、財務狀況及現金流。本項目 1A 所述及本年度報告表 10-K 其他部分所描述的風險並非完整無遺，亦非我們在業務中可能面臨的唯一風險。我們所處的環境非常競爭且快速變動。隨時間而產生的新風險與不確定性時常出現，我們無法預測這些事件或它們如何影響我們。可能還有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未知悉或目前被我們認為不重要。然而，這些風險最終可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及/或營運成果產生不利影響。
餐飲業競爭激烈。我們的競爭優勢在於所提供的食物風味、品質與價格、顧客服務、品牌識別、啤酒品質與選擇、設施吸引力、餐廳位置、氛圍與整體用餐體驗。此外，我們與其他餐廳及零售商競爭商業不動產。我們的競爭對手包括一個大型且多樣化的餐廳連鎖品牌與個別餐廳，範圍從獨立地方經營者在各個市場開設餐廳，到資金充足的全國性餐廳公司。我們許多競爭對手擁有遠較我們為多的財務、行銷及其他資源。
除了其他全服務餐廳外，我們也面臨來自多種外食替代方案的競爭，包括快速簡餐餐廳、單人份餐飲服務、速食餐廳，以及超市產業中餐飲服務與超市、熟食部門服務趨向融合的趨勢，特別是在超市業者提供「便利餐點」的形式，如改善的主菜與配菜。我們也持續面臨消費者在餐廳場合的可支配開支壓力，以及較便宜的 BJ's 替代選擇。

我們在餐飲業有效競爭的能力、BJ's 餐廳概念的成功運作，以及我們全國擴張計畫的執行，全都高度依賴 BJ's 品牌能否持續對消費者具有吸引力，並成為消費者信任的品牌。任何削弱消費者對 BJ's 品牌信任或情感的事件，都可能大幅降低該品牌的價值。如果消費者認為或體驗到我們的食物或飲料品質、服務或設施氛圍有任何下降，或以任何方式認為我們未能提供一致正面的用餐體驗，我們的競爭能力與 BJ's 品牌價值可能受到損害。此外，如果其他餐廳能透過大量折扣或其他方式提供更高的價值感，我們的顧客人數可能下降，這將對我們的營收與獲利產生不利影響。

過去，我們曾經歷某些必需品的價格大幅上漲，包括食物、商品、勞動力、員工福利、保險安排、建設、能源及其他成本。我們透過提高餐點價格來幫助抵消商品、最低工資及其他成本的上漲。然而，我們無法保證我們的餐點價格上漲會被顧客接受。如果我們的成本增加，而我們無法提高餐點價格來抵消這些成本，或我們提高的餐點價格導致顧客人數減少，則我們的營運利潤與營運成果將受到不利影響。此外，我們無法保證餐點價格上漲不會讓顧客減少造訪我們的餐廳次數，或影響他們的購買決策。
關於我們、我們的餐廳、其他餐廳或食品供應鏈中其他相關方的負面報導，無論是否正確，可能對我們的餐廳聲譽與人氣造成不利影響，並影響我們的營運成果。
